blocks.text: Day 5 · An early start, set by the National Park (7:00–8:00), for a full day in Caño Cristales: canoe, 4x4 and a 30-minute walk to the “river of five colours”. Spend 5 to 7 hours exploring the upper basin, on trails of 8 to 13 km past waterfalls, natural pools and the colours of the Macarenia clavigera, with swimming in designated pools and a picnic lunch. In the evening, a cultural performance by the river at sunset; with luck, pink river dolphins. Dinner at the lodge.
